name: Agamand Family Mace
summary: At Agamand Mills, the Agamand Family Mace remains sealed in the family crypt. Once the heirloom of a proud family in northern Lordaeron, it is now sought by their former servant, Coleman Farthing.

sections.title: A Legacy in Ruin
sections.body: Before the Third War, the Agamands held vast farmlands and windmills in northern Tirisfal Glades. Like the region’s other aristocrats, they fell to the plague of undeath. The Scourge raised them as mindless thralls in service to the Lich King, and now they wander their ruined estate. Their ancient treasures remain locked in the family crypt. Among them lies the Agamand Family Mace, a remnant of a lineage brought low.

sections.title: A Servant's Vengeance
sections.body: Coleman Farthing seeks the mace and three other martial heirlooms. The former Agamand employee blames the family for his death. Raised among the Forsaken, Farthing wants to strip the mindless Agamands of every trace of dignity and honor. He seeks their ancestral sword, axe, and dagger as well as the mace, hoping to erase his former masters’ memory and pride from the lands they once ruled.

faq.q: Where is the Agamand Family Mace located?
faq.answer: The mace rests on a weapon rack inside the Agamand Family Crypt, at the far northern end of Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Who wants the Agamand Family Mace?
faq.answer: Coleman Farthing, a Forsaken living in Brill, demands the mace and the other family heirlooms to settle an old score with his former masters.

faq.q: Why does Coleman Farthing want the heirlooms stolen?
faq.answer: Farthing served the Agamands in life and blames them for his death. Taking their prized weapons from the crypt is his way of erasing the last traces of their family honor.

faq.q: What happened to the Agamand family?
faq.answer: The Agamand family ruled the prosperous Agamand Mills in northern Lordaeron until the plague struck. Their reanimated corpses now wander the estate and crypts as mindless thralls of the Scourge.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you know how a grievance from life can drive one of your people to settle an old score.
